value.name: Asha recognizes Daniel is lying
value.description: Asha privately concludes that Daniel is lying to her and that he is not skilled at deception.
evidence: she had watched a great many people lie to her, and Daniel Serrano was lying to her now. He was not even very good at it.

value.name: Asha withholds confrontation
value.description: Asha chooses not to press Daniel yet because she does not know what he has done and does not want to force him to reveal more.
evidence: But she did not push him in that moment, because she did not yet know what he had done, and she did not want to make him do more.

value.name: Asha proposes a thorough house search
value.description: Asha asks to search the house properly with everyone present the next day and says she will bring help from her office.
evidence: "I'd like to search the house properly," she said. "With all of us present. Tomorrow, if possible. I'll bring someone from my office to help. We will go room by room."

value.name: Asha states the search will resolve the document question
value.description: Asha explains that a room-by-room search will either find the missing document or confirm it is not in the house.
evidence: "If the document is here, we will find it. If it is not here, we will know that too."

value.name: Daniel objects to the search
value.description: Daniel says the proposed search is excessive, signaling resistance to Asha's plan.

value.name: Asha insists on thoroughness
value.description: Asha counters Daniel's objection by framing the search as thorough rather than excessive.

value.name: Lucia supports Asha
value.description: Lucia agrees with Asha's plan, aligning herself with the search.

value.name: Daniel and Lucia share a silent understanding
value.description: Daniel looks at Lucia and the two siblings exchange an older, unspoken understanding before he relents.
evidence: He looked at his sister. Something passed between them that was older than this conversation. Then he said, "Fine."

value.name: Asha schedules the search
value.description: Asha sets the search for the next day at ten o'clock.

value.name: Daniel asks for a private conversation
value.description: As Asha leaves, Daniel asks to speak with her alone for a minute.
evidence: At the door, Daniel said, "Asha. Can I have a minute."

value.name: Lucia withdraws upstairs
value.description: After hesitating, Lucia goes back upstairs, leaving Daniel and Asha alone.
evidence: Lucia, after a hesitation, went back upstairs.

value.name: Daniel leads Asha onto the stoop
value.description: Daniel walks Asha outside, closes the door, and creates a private setting for confession.
evidence: Daniel walked her out onto the stoop and shut the door behind them.

value.name: Daniel begins confessing financial trouble
value.description: Daniel tells Asha he wants to be honest and starts revealing that the house is hurting him financially and that he owes money.
evidence: "I want to be honest with you," he said.
"This house is killing me. I owe money. Not a catastrophic amount, but enough that I cannot wait six months for probate to drag on."

value.name: Daniel reveals business partner risk
value.description: Daniel admits he has a business partner who is close to discovering something he wants hidden.
evidence: "I have a business partner who is about to discover something I would prefer he not discover."

value.name: Daniel admits he believed the house was his
value.description: Daniel confesses that he came to the situation believing the house belonged to him.
evidence: "I came into this thinking the house was mine."
